why: Issue #694: hud.ts toggles the mode note's --hidden modifier whenever Teams is offered. With no rule behind the class, the empty note keeps its paragraph margins in the mode row, and the stylesheet-derived --hidden sweep cannot see a class the stylesheet never names.
killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole declares every --hidden modifier hud.ts writes, so a toggled class cannot hide nothing
hud.css is syntactically whole hides the Versus mode note while Teams is offered, through the real HUD and stylesheet
